geometry.source: Only the supplied image guided this original 3D groom. All geometry and longitudinal hair maps were authored mathematically; no hair photos or external assets.

limitations: Source harness; native Three/WebGPU and art remain untested.
Face clearance uses the original equation through50 and58 rather than the rendered triangulation; the recessed ear bed is a conservative inner change.
Ear clearance uses real original ear triangles through50 and115, with source/native rounding possible.
Only sampled path centers are clearance-checked; narrow round/ribbon cross-sections and triangle interpolation receive native visual review.
Existing upper buried prefix is preserved and not claimed collision-free by this lower-path test.
